name: 13786-solodecode-glm46fp8-tp8
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1 (expert parallelism off), PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Glm4MoeForCausalLM, 92 layers (first 3 dense, 89 MoE), hidden 5120, 96 attention heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, 160 routed experts + 1 shared, top-8, vocab 151552, 202752 max positions. compressed-tensors FP8 weights and activations, bf16 KV; 361.3 GB of safetensors, so 45.2 GB per card at TP8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 40 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: 1024 prompt tokens in and 1024 output tokens out, fixed, with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0` so every request produces all 1024.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant serving one user at a time, 1024-token prompts and replies, on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit db0ffc09efddf214e279c682285c7ec68caf4e7f (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.5.5.post3-242-gdb0ffc09efd). These are server args for that commit: an unknown key is
# rejected at startup, so do not add flags from a later sglang.
# Three arguments and nothing else; every other engine setting is a stock default.

# 361.3 GB of safetensors, not cached locally -- downloads once on first use.
model-path: zai-org/GLM-4.6-FP8

tp-size: 8

# The checkpoint ships a custom chat template and tokenizer.
trust-remote-code: true
